_about: Explicit loop-slot placement for every skill hydra-stack ships. Unknown skills fall back to keyword placement in hydra_graph.py (SLOT_KEYWORDS) and show up as `unplaced` in doctor if nothing matches. Slots: start discuss plan execute verify ship learn ops gate consult tool memory.

gsd-hydra.note: the spine; reads belt --phase at every station

hydra-belt.note: the router: ~1 KB, the only always-on belt text

modulated-loop-orchestrator.note: Phase 0 router + fan-out in Discuss; Build Track gate in Plan; Baseline Check + critique in Verify

hydra-swarm.note: Prime/Hub/Leaf waves; graph contract + admission control (absorbed 2026-10-21)

hydra-evolve.note: ABSORB on every new skill/repo; CONDENSE every 3rd absorb

wisdom-memory.note: Tier 2 is now hydra-graph; Tier 3 (claude.ai) unchanged

hydra-graph.note: graph context at start; recall before fan-out; ship-tail at Ship

hydra-mem.note: raw capture via hooks; lookups via search -> timeline -> get

setup-audit.note: ops: after install and when sessions get expensive; plan: agent-readiness check on a new repo (/gsd-onboard); learn: repeated-mistake findings feed nested-learning RETRO

baton.note: grab-check .baton/ first; drop a baton when the next phase won't start this session

napkin.note: read .claude/napkin.md at start as a failed_path source

theorist.note: theory-keeper defers to it when installed (THEORY.MD home)

schematic.note: brownfield only: branch diff -> spec before Specify

razor.note: scope discipline; declined cuts -> FAILED PATHS

adversarial-execution.note: independent done-gate for user-facing/high-stakes phases; Claude Code only, else 'self-review only'

claudeception.note: skill extraction, only past nested-learning's five gates

hydra-consult.note: auto second opinion at loop points; routes to call-a-friend

veritas.note: every upload audited before work starts

research-base.note: ARS domain: load the research graph at start; same nodes/edges shape as hydra-graph

context-compact.note: harvest a long session into the graph at checkpoints

research-harvest-verified.note: structured harvest with grounding gate; writes hydra-graph's tables

book-to-skill.note: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill: one book/paper/PDF/docs folder -> on-demand chapter skill

skill-builder.note: Skill Seekers 3.10 CLI (uv tool): docs sites/repos/codebases -> skills; always --enhance-level 0, no MCP, no upload

video-course-study.note: lecture videos with no subtitles -> local transcripts + OCR'd page text -> per-module study agents -> notes; lint any quiz bank before scoring

claude-architect.note: CCA-F course decisions + course-vs-docs corrections; exam eval showed no gain over the base model (60/60 both), so load on demand

grow-as-we-go.note: after any skill runs: promised vs produced -> defect node

opera-browser-cli.note: browser evidence for adversarial-execution's UI checks

design-critique.note: UI/UX domain: critique the mockup before Plan

user-research.note: UI/UX domain: research plan / interview guide feeds Discuss

research-synthesis.note: UI/UX domain: transcripts/tickets -> themes -> decision record

design-system.note: UI/UX domain: tokens/components consistency gate in Plan

ux-copy.note: UI/UX domain: microcopy while building screens

accessibility-review.note: UI/UX domain: WCAG 2.1 AA pass beside the done-gate

design-handoff.note: UI/UX domain: spec sheet is the Ship artifact for designs

karpathy-guidelines.note: surface assumptions in Plan; surgical changes + goal-driven loop in Execute. Overlaps CLAUDE.md 'keep diffs to the task' - one home: CLAUDE.md states the rule, this skill carries the checklist

ponytail.note: lazy-senior-dev mode for the Implement step; its SessionStart hook injects ~3.5 KB every session - install the skill, enable the hook only if you want the mode flag

ponytail-review.note: second-stage (code quality) review after spec-compliance review

ponytail-audit.note: brownfield whole-repo audit before planning; pairs with schematic

ponytail-debt.note: shortcut: ledger -> failed_path/defect nodes at RETRO

ponytail-gain.note: one-shot scoreboard; its numbers are the vendor's benchmark [U]

brainstorming.note: superpowers; spine-level - use when GSD is not the spine (claude.ai native loop)

writing-plans.note: superpowers; spine-level - GSD owns Plan when installed

executing-plans.note: superpowers; spine-level - GSD owns Execute when installed

dispatching-parallel-agents.note: superpowers; Claude Code only; maps to swarm Hubs

systematic-debugging.note: superpowers; run when Verify fails, before any fix plan

verification-before-completion.note: superpowers; research-verification is its research-side twin

writing-skills.note: superpowers; alternative template to claudeception for extraction

using-superpowers.note: superpowers' auto-trigger entry point: TENSION with GSD as spine - do not install both auto-triggering spines in one project

grace-ask.note: the 'project expert': cited answers from .grace/ graph + contracts; organ-level, fires only when a project has .grace/ (mcpmarket listing = this skill)

grace-explainer.note: explains the GRACE methodology; read before adopting it as a spine

grace-cli.note: optional Bun CLI (@osovv/grace-cli); skills work without it

grace-init.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project. init creates .grace/ - adopting it means GRACE owns Spec/Plan/Execute/Verify for that repo

grace-spec.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project. GraceChangeSpec = its Specify step

grace-plan.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project. GraceChangePlan with assertions/scopes/gates

grace-execute.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project.

grace-verification.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project. deterministic V-M-* entries = its done-gate evidence

grace-reviewer.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project.

grace-refactor.note: GRACE 4 (contract-first, .grace/ XML artifacts) is a third spine candidate beside GSD and superpowers: one spine per project.

grace-refresh.note: drift between repo and .grace current state -> reconciliation change; the GRACE twin of hydra-setup's drift check

grace-setup-subagents.note: Claude Code subagent presets; TENSION with GSD's own agents
